title: PRS Database registration and marketing-readiness for letting agents and landlords

problem_severity_frequency.rationale: Mandatory database entries, per-property fee and a marketing prohibition across England, phased from Dec 2026.

buyer_budget_clarity.rationale: Letting agents and self-managing landlords are clear buyers; budget for a new entrant is unproven.

evidence_strength.rationale: Primary legislation and draft regulations plus dated secondary reporting on rollout and pricing.

distribution.rationale: Trade-body route plausible (NRLA/Propertymark) but no prospects; register is self-serve and free.

differentiation.rationale: Capped at 2: readiness is standard letting-software functionality (Lettable GBP19/month and incumbents).

validation_speed_cost.rationale: A regional pre-check test is cheap but needs agent access in the first rollout area.

economics.rationale: Capped at 2: GBP19/month anchor against a free core register; margins unproven.

founder_fit.rationale: Buildable, but distribution and incumbency are the constraints.

risk.rationale: No regulated activity; risk is commodity pricing and operator API changes.

economic_buyer.note: Letting agents and self-managing landlords in England.

painful_frequent_or_budgeted.note: Mandatory entries, per-property fee, and a statutory marketing prohibition.

non_paid_distribution.note: NRLA/Propertymark route unproven for a new entrant.
non_paid_distribution.resolve_via: Ask NRLA/Propertymark whether a vendor can reach members without paid placement and test organic acquisition.

defensible_wedge.note: Readiness is standard letting-software functionality; the core register is a free government service.

plausible_margins.note: GBP19/month anchor against a free register; margins unproven.
plausible_margins.resolve_via: Pilot paid readiness with small agents and measure conversion/CAC.

acceptable_risk.note: No regulated activity; no licence to operate required.

cheap_disconfirming_test.note: A listing pre-check for small agents in the first rollout region.

not_all_optimistic.note: Depends on paid conversion where a free register exists.
not_all_optimistic.resolve_via: Run the pilot; if agents default to the free register, the case fails.
